recent_posts.title: How Real User Feedback Solved a Bug Sentry Couldn’t Explain
recent_posts.summary: A developer solved a persistent DOM manipulation error that occurred when Google Translate interfered with React's animated typing effect. The cryptic 'removeChild' error appeared daily in Sentry logs but couldn't be reproduced until a user reported crashes when translating the page. The fix was adding a single `translate="no"` attribute to prevent Google Translate from modifying the animated text container, highlighting how user feedback can solve bugs that monitoring tools miss.
